title: Domain pack: content and marketing
description: Rules for content/marketing deliverables. Engagement is never optimized through deception. See PRD Phase 15.

rules.title: Audience, objective, and channel are defined before drafting
rules.purpose: Prevent writing generic content that fits no specific placement.
rules.requirement: brief.target_users names the actual audience, and brief.context or scope.constraints names the objective and the publishing channel/platform.
rules.evidence_requirement: All three are present and specific, not placeholders.

rules.title: Every substantive claim is substantiated
rules.purpose: Keep marketing claims honest and defensible.
rules.requirement: Any factual or comparative claim (performance numbers, 'first', 'best', 'only') traces to a source in status.verified_facts.
rules.evidence_requirement: Claims without a matching verified fact are flagged as unverified_claims, not asserted.

rules.title: No prohibited claims or deceptive persuasion tactics
rules.purpose: Keep content honest even when honesty is less persuasive.
rules.requirement: No fake urgency/scarcity, fabricated testimonial, or claim the brand cannot substantiate appears anywhere in the content.
rules.evidence_requirement: A review confirms none of these tactics are present.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 15: 'Do not optimize engagement through deception, fake urgency, invented testimonials, or unsupported statistics.'

rules.title: Brand voice, prohibited-claims list, and platform format are respected
rules.purpose: Keep the content usable as-is rather than needing a rewrite to fit the brand or platform.
rules.requirement: Any brand voice guide or platform format constraint supplied in scope.constraints is followed (length limits, tone, required disclosures).
rules.evidence_requirement: The draft matches the stated constraints.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 15: 'Voice... Brand constraints... Platform format.'

rules.title: A call to action is present and does not overpromise
rules.purpose: Give the content a clear next step without misrepresenting what happens next.
rules.scope: Content/marketing tasks whose objective includes driving an action.
rules.requirement: If the objective is to drive a specific action, the content includes a clear call to action that accurately describes what will happen.
rules.evidence_requirement: The CTA matches the actual destination/outcome.

rules.title: A review step and an outcome measurement are named
rules.purpose: Avoid publishing content with no way to check whether it worked or who approved it.
rules.requirement: acceptance.criteria or control.stop_conditions names who reviews/approves the content, and how its outcome will be measured after publishing.
rules.evidence_requirement: Both elements are present in the contract.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 15: 'Review and approval. Outcome measurement.'
